items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: Well the band was just for myself, Joe Oliver, Kei Ori, Johnny Dot, Lorenzo Stahl, banjo player, Bob Lyon, bass player.

ctx.x: Who else was in the band when you joined Ori?
Well the band was just for myself, Joe Oliver, Kei Ori, Johnny Dot, Lorenzo Stahl, banjo player, Bob Lyon, bass player.
Excuse me, how's Lorenzo Stahl spelled his last name? Is it S-T-A-L-L? Do you remember?

items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: Well, on a Monday night, we were playing at the Columny Hall. And, uh, Ori and Johnny Dash, they were looking for that paper, you know.

ctx.x: Was you called in the next draft, I mean next call, I was supposed to go in the next one? I was called in the first one. They had me working in the shipyard in the morning. I was so happy. I said, everyone knock off, everything's okay. No more work. Boy, I jumped on top of the streetcar. Listen, you want me to talk? Yeah. You want me to talk? Yeah. You want me to talk?

Yeah. You want me to talk direct? Right. Huh? Yeah. I'm betting your remembrance background. Well, on a Monday night, we were playing at the Columny Hall. And, uh, Ori and Johnny Dash, they were looking for that paper, you know. They was worried about that paper. And I was the first one got the paper. I got the paper on a Monday morning. Well, at night, I went to the hall. And Johnny Dash was playing. And God soon didn't know what Johnny Dash was playing. Like a drunken fellow. I was worried. What's the light up…
